This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year. This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that. You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have: Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI. Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily. Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies. The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match: You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role Join a data infrastructure and analytics team building a platform that turns information from many sources into reliable, current company intelligence. You will own the platform end to end, from architecture and ingestion through production operations, helping power downstream products with trusted data. What You'll Do Design and build a multi-source data platform for concurrent ingestion, event-driven processing, and orchestrated batch workflows. Ingest data from provider APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping, with rate limiting and robust failure handling. Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect. Build messaging and task queue workflows with retries, dead-letter queues, and controlled replay. Preserve original payloads in Google Cloud Storage and transform data with dbt into raw, standardized, and curated layers. Develop idempotent upserts, data contracts, automated quality checks, pipeline tests, and monitoring for freshness and failures. Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and loading patterns for reliable downstream use. Integrate data enrichment and LLM-based structured extraction into the platform. What We're Looking For 5 to 10 or more years of experience, including production ownership of multi-source data platforms from architecture through deployment and ongoing operation. Strong hands-on experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools, dbt, and Google Cloud Platform. Experience building event-driven systems with messaging or task queues and asynchronous processing. Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and incremental loading. Proficiency in Python and concurrent or asynchronous processing, such as asyncio, aiohttp, or HTTPX. Practical web scraping experience with tools such as Scrapy, Playwright, or Selenium. Experience with data contracts, storage layers, and automated data quality checks. Entity resolution is valuable; BigQuery, Dataform, and LLM-based structured extraction are helpful. Comfort working in a startup or small team with broad ownership and adaptability. Compensation & Benefits Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Remote. Originally posted on Himalayas
